title: Bias Against 93 Stigmatized Groups in Masked Language Models and Downstream Sentiment Classification Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting Masked Language Models (MLMs) using templates based on the Social Distance Scale to evaluate the probability of negative word predictions, and measuring the proportion of negative classifications in downstream sentiment analysis models.
